examples.vi: Kẻ trộm đã lấy cắp túi xách của cô ấy khi cô đang xem quần áo.

examples.en: Police caught the car thief two hours after the crime.
examples.vi: Cảnh sát đã bắt được tên trộm ô tô hai giờ sau vụ án.

thesaurus.definition: a criminal who takes property belonging to someone else with the intention of keeping it or selling it

wiktionary.gloss: One who carries out a theft.
wiktionary.vi: kẻ trộm; kẻ cắp; kẻ ăn trộm

wiktionary.gloss: One who steals another person's property, especially by stealth and without using force or violence.

idioms.gloss: Used to call attention to the fact that one is being robbed and to request aid in stopping the thief.
People are more likely to steal something if presented with a convenient opportunity to do so.
If one puts off doing what one ought to do, one will end up not having enough time to do it properly.
idioms.phrase: procrastination is the thief of time

idioms.gloss: Comparing one's own situation with that of others will lead to unhappiness or bitterness.
idioms.phrase: comparison is the thief of joy

idioms.gloss: People are easily tempted to dishonesty if there is a substantial prize to be gained.
idioms.phrase: a fair booty makes many a thief

idioms.gloss: To employ an unscrupulous person in order to catch another unscrupulous person.
idioms.phrase: set a thief to catch a thief

tatoeba.en: Once a thief, always a thief.
tatoeba.vi: Ăn cắp quen tay, ngủ ngày quen mắt.

tatoeba.en: Yesterday, a thief entered the house.
tatoeba.vi: Hôm qua, một tên trộm đã đột nhập vào nhà.

tatoeba.en: The policeman is running to catch the thief.
tatoeba.vi: Viên cảnh sát đang chạy để bắt tên trộm.

tatoeba.en: There is indisputable proof that Tom is the thief.
tatoeba.vi: Có một bằng chứng không thể chối cãi chứng minh rằng Tom là kẻ trộm.

tatoeba.en: The police need more information to catch the thief.
tatoeba.vi: Cảnh sát cần thêm thông tin để bắt được tên trộm.
